protocol.description: Institutional-grade Ethereum liquid staking protocol. Users deposit ETH and receive LsETH (cToken-style ERC-20 rebasing receipt). Stake is delegated round-robin to a permissioned consortium of enterprise node operators (Coinbase Cloud, Figment, Staked, Blockdaemon) coordinated by Alluvial. Governance is multisig-only: three Gnosis Safes (proxy_admin 4-of-7, governor 4-of-7 with same signers, executor 2-of-3). No on-chain Governor, no Timelock, no Snapshot, no active TLC token-based governance as of profile date. Original codebase (River protocol). No bug bounty program at ~$767M TVS.

The 24-hour reporting cadence is an off-chain convention, not an enforced on-chain freshness bound.
